director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 6 hai, kyunki 12 hisse 4 ke teen guna hain, toh rang wale 2 bhi teen guna hue: 2 × 3 = 6. Yahan tak theek hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Achha, cricket par thodi der mein zaroor lautenge. Abhi apne kaam par wapas chalte hain. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar gap mein kati hai. Beech ka mark 4/8 hai, aur wahi 1/2 bhi hai aur 2/4 bhi. Toh 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: ek jagah, teen naam. Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?

seams.form: Abhi apne kaam par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: chhe gap chalne honge
Sahi jawab, kyunki line par har 1/4 mein 1/8 wale 2 gap hain, toh 3/4 tak 3 × 2 = 6 gap, yaani 6/8. Sixer ki baat tumne ki thi: tab tumhare saath kaun tha?
Virat

Achha, toh Virat! Yeh batane ke liye shukriya. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum saath mein karte hain. Sana ek rumal ko aadha modti hai aur ek aadhe mein rang bharti hai. Phir use do baar aur aadha modti hai. Teeno mod ke baad rumal kholo, toh kul kitne barabar hisse dikhenge?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum saath mein karte hain.

j2.line: Achha, toh Virat! Yeh batane ke liye shukriya.

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Kaagaz ko ek baar modkar kholo, aur dekho ki pehle ka ek hissa ab kitne hisson mein bata hai. Ek rumal ko teen baar, har baar aadha moda; kholne par kul kitne barabar hisse dikhenge?
pata nahi

Har mod par har hissa do mein bant-ta hai, isliye hisse har baar dugne hote hain, aur teen mod ke baad 8 ho jaate hain. Rumal ke 8 barabar hisse hain, toh har chhota hissa poore rumal ka 1/8 hai. Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: aadhe hisson mein

Haan, sahi hai. Hisse badle, par rumal par rang utna hi raha. Toh poora jawab: kholne par 8 barabar hisse hain aur 4 mein rang, yaani 4/8, jo 1/2 ke barabar hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Do ek jaisi chocolate hain. Mohit ne ek chocolate ka 1/2 khaya. Anjali ne doosri ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 khaaye. Zyada kisne khaya: Mohit ne, Anjali ne, ya dono ne barabar khaya?
director.card: Do ek jaisi chocolate hain. Mohit ne ek chocolate ka 1/2 khaya. Anjali ne doosri ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 khaaye. Zyada kisne khaya: Mohit ne, Anjali ne, ya dono ne barabar khaya?

director.text: both

Sahi jawab, kyunki 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 hisse 3/6 hain, aur 3/6 = 1/2, isliye dono ne barabar khaya. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap mein kati hai. Is line par 5/12, 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?
director.card: Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap mein kati hai. Is line par 5/12, 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?

director.text: kam

Bilkul sahi: 5/12 is line par paanchve mark par hai, aur 1/2 = 6/12 chhatthe mark par, isliye 5/12 chhota hai. Modne par 1/2 se 2/4 bana: kul hisse aur rang wale hisse, dono dugne hue, aur rang utna hi raha. Ab bina mode, guna karke barabar fraction banayenge. Yahan tak saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Is patti ke 5 barabar hisse hain aur 2 mein rang, yaani 2/5. Neeche ka 5 saare hisse ginta hai, aur upar ka 2 rang wale. Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par har hissa 2 chhote hisson mein kata hai. Pehli patti ke rang wale 2 hisse, nayi patti mein kitne chhote hisse bante hain?

director.text: chaar bata das

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki har rang wala hissa 2 bana, toh 4. Is patti mein rang 4/10 hai, aur yahi 2/5 bhi hai. Neeche 5 × 2 = 10 aur upar 2 × 2 = 4: dono ek hi number se guna hue. Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?
director.card: Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?

director.text: 10/6 sahi nahi hai. Isko doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Patti ka har hissa 2 mein kaato, toh kul hisse bhi dugne hote hain aur rang wale hisse bhi. Isliye upar aur neeche, dono number 2 se guna hote hain, koi ek nahi. 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?

seams.form: Isko doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: 12 mein se 10

Isi line par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre mark par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo, toh 2/4 banta hai. 2/4 is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par aayega?
